v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of asset-cleanup-daily skill.

- Automates daily cleanup of expired temp files, old logs, stale locks/caches, and expired media assets at 03:00 via Cron.
- Outputs detailed cleanup reports, including counts and freed disk space for each file type.
- Integrates cleanly with infrastructure: uses JUEJIN_HOME, atomic_write, db_logger, and respects main environment constraints.
- Handles errors gracefully: supports dry-run mode, partial cleanup on failures (e.g., database unavailable), and robust logging.
- Complements log-rotate Cron, focusing on data/ directory assets without affecting live production data or triggering alerts.
